source_bindings.primary_sources: Eleven original QE files and four existing Python reference/helper files are byte-bound in additional_receipt; original complete material source-map text remains untouched.

public_API.qe_nc_upf.read_nc_upf: read_nc_upf(path, *, expected_sha256: str, expected_bytes: int|str) -> NCUPF. Verifies the same original bytes parsed and retains original_bytes/path/sha256. NCUPF has r/rab/local_ry (mesh,), beta_r (mesh,nbeta), angular_l/cutoff_indices (nbeta,), raw_dij (nbeta,nbeta), local_mesh, beta_mesh, zero-based channel_radial/channel_l/channel_lm (nh,), expanded_d (nh,nh), nbeta and nh. Selected scalar Ni/H PBE NC only; no USPP/PAW/NLCC/SOC. Arrays readonly.
public_API.qe_nc_upf.expand_channels: expand_channels(angular_l, raw_dij) -> (channel_radial, channel_l, channel_lm, expanded_d); QE radial then real-harmonic channel order, D gated by matching l/lm.
public_API.qe_nc_radial.build_radial_tables: build_radial_tables(upf, omega_bohr3, qmax_bohr_inv) -> NCRadialTables. Construct ONCE per species/volume/range, qmax covering PW momenta and density G. Stores native dq=.01 cubic tables with four-point guard, beta 4pi/sqrt(omega), local 4pi/omega, distinct G0. No atom function rebuilds tables.
public_API.NCRadialTables.vloc: vloc(q_bohr_inv[nq]) -> float64[nq] Ry centered Fourier coefficients, ordinary erf Coulomb-tail restoration and separate alpha-Z G0. Exactly zero labels G0; supported lattice nonzero G are separated from native epsilon threshold.
public_API.qe_nc_radial.helpers: qe_simpson_weights(rab[n]) -> weights[n], native even-mesh correction retained; qe_spherical_bessel(l,x) -> matching-shaped native s/p/d Bessel values.
public_API.qe_nc_projectors.centered_projectors: centered_projectors(tables, momenta_bohr_inv[npw,3]) -> complex128 B[npw,nh], includes QE harmonics and (-i)^l, excludes atom phase. Reuse per species and identical momentum rows across atoms/spins.
public_API.qe_nc_projectors.place_projectors: place_projectors(centered[npw,nh], momenta_bohr_inv[npw,3], position_bohr[3]) -> B[npw,nh] with exp[-i p.tau].
public_API.qe_nc_projectors.atom_projectors: atom_projectors(tables,momenta_bohr_inv,position_bohr,*,centered=None) -> (B[npw,nh], realD[nh,nh]); D shares upf.expanded_d, B D B-dagger is Ry. Caller orders atoms by species then original atom order.
public_API.qe_nc_projectors.qe_real_harmonics: qe_real_harmonics(momenta_bohr_inv[npw,3],lmax) -> float64[npw,(lmax+1)^2]; lmax 0,1,2; QE order m0,cos,sin; Condon-Shortley signs.

new_oracle.thresholds: Native comparator rtol=2e-10, atol=2e-11; adaptive finite-radial quadrature rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-7; elementary explicit limits in source. Metrics saved before failure including exceptions/nonfinite evidence.
